Subject: Elliptic Health — migration readiness & next tests (post-demo)

Hi Sara — great to meet today, thanks for the run-through. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

What we heard from you:
- Primary goal: migrate their document ingestion + summarization pipeline from hyperscaler endpoints to a vendor that offers predictable latency and lower token cost for high-volume nightly jobs.
- Must preserve OpenAI-compatibility for the existing SDK calls (minimal code changes across services).
- Security & procurement: standard SOC2 evidence + an initial data residency conversation.

Redwood differentiators we covered:
- OpenAI-compatible REST surface with a drop-in SDK shim and a local "compat" layer for prompt/response parity.
- Cost controls: batching + KV caching options to reduce per-token spend during nightly runs.
- Fallback routing to a cheaper quantized model for non-critical inference to meet cost SLOs.

Suggested next tests (I attached a starter CSV with test cases):
1) Smoke: run 1k representative prompts through Redwood using your OpenAI-compatible SDK swap (same client code, change endpoint). Verify response structure and function-calling parity. (Owner: Elliptic engineering)
2) Latency/cold-start: measure p95 for batch sizes matching nightly run (owner: Redwood / Marissa to coordinate infra).
3) Tokenization & prompt-diff check: compare token counts and a small sample of prompt->response diffs; flag any semantic regressions.
4) Security review: initial SOC2 artifact packet and list of audit questions we need. (Owner: procurement@elliptichealth.com)

Files attached: redwood-elliptic-compat-test-plan.csv (test matrix), elliptic-ma-draft.pdf (commercial starting point).

Can you confirm: 1) who on your side will own the smoke test, and 2) whether procurement should be looped now or after the first smoke run?

If that works, Rishi and Marissa will schedule a short technical sync to hand off the test harness and discuss the SDK shim.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
